mapper.select: select mn.*, pp.P_Name as blxwProjectName, si.Sec_Name as blxwSectionName, con.Con_Name as blxwContractName, su.U_Name as blxwResponsibleUnitLeaderName, sc.C_Name as blxwResponsibleUnitName, sd.D_Name as blxwLevelName from Blxw_Info mn left join Pre_Project pp on mn.Blxw_Project_Id = pp.P_Id left join Sec_Info si on mn.Blxw_Section_Id = si.Sec_Id left join Con_Contract con on mn.Blxw_Contract_Id = con.Con_Id left join SYS_User su on mn.Blxw_Responsible_Unit_Leader_Id = su.U_Id left join SYS_Company sc on mn.Blxw_Responsible_Unit_Id = sc.C_Id left join sys_dictionary sd on mn.Blxw_Level = sd.D_Code and sd.D_ParentID='0a42a0d7-7a5f-4159-a8a5-ce1edef76584' where mn.id = #{id}
select * from Blxw_Info where Blxw_Type_Ids like concat('%',#{id} ,'%')
select Blxw_Name from Blxw_Type where id = #{type}

select ni.*, mn.Blxw_Number as blxwNumber, mn.Blxw_Project_Id as blxwProjectId,mn.Blxw_Section_Id as blxwSectionId, mn.Blxw_Contract_Id as blxwContractId, mn.Blxw_Start_Time as blxwStartTime,mn.Blxw_End_Time as blxwEndTime, mn.Blxw_Responsible_Unit_Id as blxwResponsibleUnitId, mn.Blxw_Responsible_Unit_Leader_Id as blxwResponsibleUnitLeaderId,mn.Blxw_Talk_Time as blxwTalkTime, mn.Blxw_Talk_Place as blxwTalkPlace, mn.Blxw_Type_Ids as blxwTypeIds, mn.Blxw_Type_Names as blxwTypeNames, mn.Blxw_Level,mn.Blxw_Deduct_Score as blxwDeductScore, mn.Blxw_Measures as blxwMeasures, mn.Blxw_Handle_Type as blxwHandleType, mn.Blxw_Rectify_Time as blxwRectifyTime,mn.supporting_annex as supportingAnnex, mn.supporting_document as blxwSupportingDocument,mn.is_history as blxwIsHistory, mn.Blxw_Rectify_Require as blxwRectifyRequire, mn.Blxw_State as blxwState, pp.P_Name as blxwProjectName, si.Sec_Name as blxwSectionName, con.Con_Name as blxwContractName, su.U_Name as blxwResponsibleUnitLeaderName, sc.C_Name as blxwResponsibleUnitName from Notice_Info ni left join Blxw_Info mn on mn.id = ni.Source_Id left join Pre_Project pp on mn.Blxw_Project_Id = pp.P_Id left join Sec_Info si on mn.Blxw_Section_Id = si.Sec_Id left join Con_Contract con on mn.Blxw_Contract_Id = con.Con_Id left join SYS_User su on mn.Blxw_Responsible_Unit_Leader_Id = su.U_Id left join SYS_Company sc on mn.Blxw_Responsible_Unit_Id = sc.C_Id where ni.id = #{id} and ni.Source_Code = 'blxwInfo'

select mn.*, pp.P_Name as blxwProjectName, si.Sec_Name as blxwSectionName, con.Con_Name as blxwContractName, su.U_Name as blxwResponsibleUnitLeaderName, sc.C_Name as blxwResponsibleUnitName ,sd1.D_Name as blxwLevelName, sd2.D_Name as blxwHandleTypeName from Blxw_Info mn left join Pre_Project pp on mn.Blxw_Project_Id = pp.P_Id left join Sec_Info si on mn.Blxw_Section_Id = si.Sec_Id left join Con_Contract con on mn.Blxw_Contract_Id = con.Con_Id left join SYS_User su on mn.Blxw_Responsible_Unit_Leader_Id = su.U_Id left join SYS_Company sc on mn.Blxw_Responsible_Unit_Id = sc.C_Id left join Sys_Dictionary sd1 on mn.Blxw_Level = sd1.D_Code left join Sys_Dictionary sd2 on mn.Blxw_Handle_Type = sd2.D_Code where mn.id = #{id} and sd1.D_ParentID = (SELECT D_Id FROM Sys_Dictionary WHERE D_Code = 'JPMsoft_BLXWDJ') and sd2.D_ParentID = (SELECT D_Id FROM Sys_Dictionary WHERE D_Code = 'JPMsoft_CLFS')

select infoclose.*,mn.Blxw_Number as blxwNumber, mn.Blxw_Project_Id as blxwProjectId,mn.Blxw_Section_Id as blxwSectionId, mn.Blxw_Contract_Id as blxwContractId, mn.Blxw_Start_Time as blxwStartTime,mn.Blxw_End_Time as blxwEndTime, mn.Blxw_Responsible_Unit_Id as blxwResponsibleUnitId, mn.Blxw_Responsible_Unit_Leader_Id as blxwResponsibleUnitLeaderId,mn.Blxw_Talk_Time as blxwTalkTime, mn.Blxw_Talk_Place as blxwTalkPlace, mn.Blxw_Type_Ids as blxwTypeIds, mn.Blxw_Type_Names as blxwTypeNames, mn.Blxw_Level,mn.Blxw_Deduct_Score as blxwDeductScore, mn.Blxw_Measures as blxwMeasures, mn.Blxw_Handle_Type as blxwHandleType, mn.Blxw_Rectify_Time as blxwRectifyTime, mn.supporting_annex as supportingAnnex, mn.supporting_document as blxwSupportingDocument,mn.is_history as blxwIsHistory, mn.Blxw_Rectify_Require as blxwRectifyRequire, mn.Blxw_State as blxwState, pp.P_Name as blxwProjectName, si.Sec_Name as blxwSectionName, con.Con_Name as blxwContractName, su.U_Name as blxwResponsibleUnitLeaderName, sc.C_Name as blxwResponsibleUnitName from Notice_Info_Close infoclose left join Blxw_Info mn on mn.id = infoclose.Source_Id left join Pre_Project pp on mn.Blxw_Project_Id = pp.P_Id left join Sec_Info si on mn.Blxw_Section_Id = si.Sec_Id left join Con_Contract con on mn.Blxw_Contract_Id = con.Con_Id left join SYS_User su on mn.Blxw_Responsible_Unit_Leader_Id = su.U_Id left join SYS_Company sc on mn.Blxw_Responsible_Unit_Id = sc.C_Id where infoclose.Id = #{id}

select mn.*, pp.P_Name as blxwProjectName, si.Sec_Name as blxwSectionName, con.Con_Name as blxwContractName, su.U_Name as blxwResponsibleUnitLeaderName, sc.C_Name as blxwResponsibleUnitName, sd.D_Name as blxwLevelName from Blxw_Info mn left join Pre_Project pp on mn.Blxw_Project_Id = pp.P_Id left join Sec_Info si on mn.Blxw_Section_Id = si.Sec_Id left join Con_Contract con on mn.Blxw_Contract_Id = con.Con_Id left join SYS_User su on mn.Blxw_Responsible_Unit_Leader_Id = su.U_Id left join SYS_Company sc on mn.Blxw_Responsible_Unit_Id = sc.C_Id left join sys_dictionary sd on mn.Blxw_Level = sd.D_Code and sd.D_ParentID='0a42a0d7-7a5f-4159-a8a5-ce1edef76584'
mn.Blxw_Handle_Type = '02' and mn.Blxw_State = 7 and mn.close_status = 'unclosed' and mn.id not in (select infoclose.Source_Id from Notice_Info_Close infoclose where infoclose.state !=3)

select mn.*, pp.P_Name as blxwProjectName, si.Sec_Name as blxwSectionName, con.Con_Name as blxwContractName, su.U_Name as blxwResponsibleUnitLeaderName, sc.C_Name as blxwResponsibleUnitName, sd.D_Name as blxwLevelName from Blxw_Info mn left join Pre_Project pp on mn.Blxw_Project_Id = pp.P_Id left join Sec_Info si on mn.Blxw_Section_Id = si.Sec_Id left join Con_Contract con on mn.Blxw_Contract_Id = con.Con_Id left join SYS_User su on mn.Blxw_Responsible_Unit_Leader_Id = su.U_Id left join SYS_Company sc on mn.Blxw_Responsible_Unit_Id = sc.C_Id left join sys_dictionary sd on mn.Blxw_Level = sd.D_Code and sd.D_ParentID='0a42a0d7-7a5f-4159-a8a5-ce1edef76584'
mn.Blxw_Handle_Type = '01' and mn.Blxw_State = 7
